name: SikaShield P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m²
paste:
SIKASHIELD® P02 PE ROLLBASE 2 KG/M²: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaShield® P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m², April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikashield-p02-perollbase2kgm.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaShield® P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m² where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaShield® P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m² is an APP modified bituminous separation layer used as a base sheet for torch applied bituminous roof membranes which cannot be directly applied to the roof substrate. The membrane can be applied using various application methods to wood or metal substrates with or without existing waterproofing membranes. The underside is coated with an exposed non-woven polyester fabric which is absorbent and traps any residual moisture from wooden substrates or old waterproofing membranes. It is reinforced with fibreglass to ensure dimensional stability. Top surface finish: polyethylene film. Weight: ~2,0 kg/m²
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. The Product is used as a waterproofing membrane for:
    - Flat or sloping roofs
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Roof waterproofing accessory for.
    - Flat and sloped roofs as a base sheet and/or water vapour transmission layer for torch applied bituminous roof membranes
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaShield® P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m²
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Plastomeric modified bituminous roof membrane separation layer (Formerly Index Rollbase 2kg/m2 )
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - CE Marking and Declaration of Performance based on EN 13970 - Bitumen water vapour control layers
    - CE marking and declaration of performance based on EN 13707:2004+A2:2009 Flexible sheets for waterproofing — Reinforced bitumen sheets for roof waterproofing
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13970: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 13707:2004+A2: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1848-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Packaging (p.1).
    - EN1849-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Mass per area (p.2).
    - EN12311-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - EN12310-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tear strength (p.2).
    - EN 1109: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexibility at low temperature (p.2).
    - EN 1928: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Watertightness (p.2).
    - EN 1931: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Water-vapour transmission rate (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Several methods of application: mechanically fixed, torch applied, cold bitumen adhesive or hot bitumen
    - Flexibility at low temperature: ≤ -10 °C
    - Good tensile and elongation
    - High tear resistance
    - Good water vapour transmission
2.5 Composition.
    | Composition | APP modified bitumen |
    | Reinforcing material | Fibreglass mat coupled with “non- |
    | woven” polyester fabric |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.6 Appearance and colour.
    | Top surface | Polyethylene film |
    | Backing | Non-woven polyester fabric |
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Mass per area: 2,0 kg/m² ± 0,2 kg/m² (EN1849-1)
    - Flexibility at low temperature: ≤ -10 °C (EN 1109)
    - Watertightness: 60 kPa (EN 1928-Method A)
    - Water-vapour transmission rate: µ = 100 000 ± 20 % (EN 1931)
2.8 Tensile strength.
    | Longitudinal | 500 N/50 mm ± 100 N/50 mm |
    | Transversal | 350 N/50 mm ±   70 N/50 mm |
    Test method printed: (EN12311-1)
2.9 Elongation.
    | Longitudinal | 50 % ± 15 % |
    | Transversal | 50 % ± 15 % |
    Test method printed: (EN12311-1)
2.10 Tear strength.
    | Longitudinal | 200 N ± 60 N |
    | Transversal | 200 N ± 60 N |
    Test method printed: (EN12310-1)
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 36 months from date of production
2.12 Packaging.
    | Roll width | 1.05 m |
    | Roll length | 10.0 m |
    | Refer to current price list for packaging variations. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 1848-1)
2.13 Storage conditions. The Product must be stored in original unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions and temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Protect the Product from direct weather exposure and sunlight. Store in a vertical position. Do not stack pallets of the rolls on top of each other, or under pallets of any other materials during transport or storage. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - The supporting structure must be of sufficient structural strength to apply all new and existing layers of the roof build-up. Complete roof system must be designed and secured against wind uplift loadings.
    - The substrate must be uniform, firm, smooth and free of any sharp protrusion or burrs, clean, dry, free of grease, bitumen, oil, dust and loosely adhering particles.
3.3 Substrate preparation. Use the appropriate preparation equipment to achieve the required substrate quality.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Installation procedure
    - Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
    - Alignment
    - Unroll, align and re-roll correctly before permanently installing.
    - Overlaps
    - Side: 100mm. End: 150 mm.
    - Fastening
    - SikaShield® P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m² can be mechanically fixed on the substrate by using large-headed fasteners. Contact Sika® Technical Services for additional information.
    - Torch-on overlaps
    - When allowed by the substrate, the overlaps are sealed using a gas burner. Over wood deck do not use torching: the overlaps should be nailed down every 10 cm with 1cm large-head nails.
    - Hot bitumen or cold bitumen adhesive bonding Apply the appropriate product from the SikaBit® Hot Melt or Sika® Igolflex® range, at the correct consumption to the prepared substrate. Refer to the individual Product Data Sheets.
    - Protection
    - The membrane must be protected from damage during any ongoing site activities.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - At low temperatures, take care unrolling to avoid damaging the membrane.
    - Use suitable footwear to avoid puncturing the membrane.
    - Do not over-torch the membrane otherwise the polyester reinforcement (which melts at +260 °C) will be damaged making the membrane un-useable.
    - If membrane is insufficiently heated, this can cause reduced adhesion to the substrate, between layers or on the overlaps. If this occurs, un-bonded areas must be lifted and re-torched.
    - If a seasonal symbol is printed on the roll’s label, it is advisable to use the membrane during the indicated season.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature.
    | Minimum | +5 °C |
    | Maximum | +40 °C |
5.3 Substrate temperature.
    | Minimum | +5 °C |
    | Maximum | +40 °C |
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - At low temperatures, take care unrolling to avoid damaging the membrane.
    - Do not over-torch the membrane otherwise the polyester reinforcement (which melts at +260 °C) will be damaged making the membrane un-useable.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Packaging: Roll width | 1.05 m; Roll length | 10.0 m; Refer to current price list for packaging variations. (EN 1848-1)
    - Mass per area: 2,0 kg/m² ± 0,2 kg/m² (EN1849-1)
    - Tensile strength: Longitudinal | 500 N/50 mm ± 100 N/50 mm; Transversal | 350 N/50 mm ±   70 N/50 mm (EN12311-1)
    - Elongation: Longitudinal | 50 % ± 15 %; Transversal | 50 % ± 15 % (EN12311-1)
    - Tear strength: Longitudinal | 200 N ± 60 N; Transversal | 200 N ± 60 N (EN12310-1)
    - Flexibility at low temperature: ≤ -10 °C (EN 1109)
    - Watertightness: 60 kPa (EN 1928-Method A)
    - Water-vapour transmission rate: µ = 100 000 ± 20 % (EN 1931)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaShield® P02 PE Rollbase 2 kg/m², April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikashield-p02-perollbase2kgm.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
